answer_1.quote: We evaluate classification and generation tasks separately. ... For generation tasks, the evaluation metrics include DS, DG onlyQ, DG otherA, DG otherQ, DG otherAQ, and DG Avg, which assess detoxification performance across various adversarial inputs. ... We choose SafeEdit, AlpacaEval, Harm-fulQA/DangerousQA as the datasets.

answer_2.quote: Fluency is measured using n-grams to evaluate the helpfulness of generation. ... Metrics such as DS (Defense Success Rate), DG metrics, ASR, Harmful Score, WinR1, WinR2, and TrueR are reported.

answer_3.quote: We also use GPT-4o as an additional classifier. Evaluations by RoBERTa and GPT-4o indicate that DSCD can be effectively applied on top of existing alignment approaches... For AlpacaEval we compare outputs generated with DSCD to those from OpenAI's Text-Davinci-003 and GPT-4o, calculating the win rate using ChatGPT.
